An <c:ffff00>offensive<c> <c:ffff00>skill<c> for handling <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> with weapon
mechanisms for <c:ffff00>attacking<c> nearby opponents.
<c:ffff00>Actions<c> that make a <c:ffff00>melee attack<c> belong to it.

The higher the <c:ffff00>{{skill_level}}<c>, the faster the <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and
<c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> and the higher the <c:ffff00>{{success_power}}<c>.

On Striking {{part|pl}}, the <c:ffff00>{{power}} stat<c> rises when the
<c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> fills.
